lines: Bhavya Kapoor is an Investor Selling Shareholder offering up to 4,500 shares, with proceeds of up to ₹0.61 crore if all offered shares are sold; this is an estimate and employee-portion shares sell at a discount, so actual proceeds will be slightly lower.
Timing is tied to the listing, with trading start printed as March 11, 2026, which makes this a timely moment to discuss liquidity from the sale.
She would retain an estimated ₹1.42 crore, valued at the offer price, and the up-to ₹0.45 crore gain is before offer expenses and taxes.
Identity is verified in the seller table, but holdings appear in only one section (promoter_holding), so confidence is medium.
